工作忙、生活忙，我們常把時間留給工作、朋友和各種待辦事項，但你一天之中，有多少時間真正留給家人呢？👨‍👩‍👧‍👦💛
如果想用英文聊聊「陪伴家人的時間」，除了說 I love my family.，還可以怎麼自然地表達？
這一集從一個簡單卻很貼近生活的問題開始：
💬 Do you spend a lot of time with your family?
你會花很多時間陪伴家人嗎？
一起學會 spend time with somebody、because of + Noun，聊聊家人、生活與陪伴。
💬 A. QUESTION｜口說練習
Question: Do you spend a lot of time with your family?
• Yes, exactly so. I have a small family, and there are only four members, my dad, my mom, my sister and me. We have a strong bond among us and that makes us a happy family. So we spend lots of time together. We enjoy cooking together. We catch up on news and talk about our lives.
• Unfortunately not very much. Um … I wish I could. I try to spend more time with my family, but actually, we don't live in the same city. Because of my work, I live alone in another city far from my family, so, I am only able to spend about two weeks per year with them.
✨ B. LANGUAGE FOCUS｜學習焦點
1. spend time + with somebody
• I try to spend more time with my family.
• I am only able to spend about two weeks per year with them.
2. because of + Noun
• Because of my work, I live alone in another city far from my family.
• Because of the typhoon, there will be no school tomorrow.
📚 C. WORDS & PHRASES｜詞彙片語
exactly /ɪɡˈzæktli/ (adv.) 確切地
member /ˈmɛmbɚ/ (n.) 成員，一分子
strong /strɑŋ; strɔŋ/ (adj.) 強壯的；強烈的
bond /bɑnd/ (n.) 聯繫；關係
among /əˈmʌŋ/ (prep.) 在……中；為……所環繞
catch up on (phr.) 讓……了解最新情況
unfortunately /ʌnˈfɔrtʃənətli/ (adv.) 不幸地
actually /ˈæktʃuəli/ (adv.) 實際上；事實上
per /pɝ; pɚ/ (prep.) 每，每一
be able to (phr.) 能夠

🌟 本集學習重點
✔️ 用 spend time with somebody 表達「花時間陪伴某人」。
✔️ 用 because of + Noun 說明「因為……」而產生的結果。
✔️ 學會 strong bond、catch up on、be able to 等實用片語，讓你不只會介紹家庭成員，也能進一步聊聊彼此的關係與相處方式。
🎧 學完這一集，也試著問問自己：Do you spend a lot of time with your family?
下一次用英文聊天時，不妨從「家人」開始，練習說出屬於自己的答案！
